title: Admissions
note:
Admissions Considerations Option table
1. Required to be considered for admission. It is not available for ADMCON12.
3. Not considered for admission, even if submitted
5. Not required for admission, but considered if submitted

Status of Students table
1. Applicants
2. Admits
3. Enrolled Full-time
4. Enrolled Part-time
5. Total enrolled - will be generated on export file. Do not include in import file.
6. Percent enrolled - will be generated on export file. Do not include in import file.

Race/ethnicity table
1 - Nonresident alien
2 - Hispanic/Latino
3 - American Indian or Alaska Native
4 - Asian
5 - Black or African American
6 - Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander
7 - White
8 - Two or more races
9 - Race and ethnicity unknown
10 - Total will be generated. Do not include in import file.
11 - Grand total will be generated. Do not include in import file.
nameFl:

Applies to: Institutions with entering first-time and transfer-in degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate students
File type: Fixed Length/Positional (*.txt)
noteFL:
Note: If "Other Test"(Part A or Part E) is the only requirement other than a diploma or equivalent, and few students are not admitted due to this test, your institution is open enrollment. Please contact the Help Desk to correct your response to this question.
All numeric fields should be right-justified. Both leading zeros and spaces are permissible. Character data should be left-justified.
The PARTs in the import specifications do not align directly to the survey parts.

fixedLayoutFields.name: ADM_OPEN
fixedLayoutFields.description:
1. For the Fall 2025 admission cycle, did your institution have an open admission policy under which virtually all students that completed a high school diploma (or received a GED/other equivalent) were admitted for all or most entering undergraduate-level programs?
[Part A - Screening Questions 1]
fixedLayoutFields.validEntry:
Institutions that require only an Ability to Benefit (ATB) or similar test beyond the high school diploma/equivalent, and only reject a very small number of students based on the test, are also considered open admission.

If your institution has one or more programs with admissions requirements, you should select ‘no’ to this question.

1 - Yes, all undergraduate-level programs at the institution are open admission.
2 - No, all or nearly all undergraduate-level programs at the institution have admission requirements. (i.e., all or nearly all entering students are evaluated against admission criteria to be granted admission to the institution)
3 - No, only one or a few undergraduate-level programs at the institution have admission requirements. (i.e., all or nearly all programs are open admission; only students applying to a limited number of programs are evaluated against admission criteria to be granted admission to the institution)

fixedLayoutFields.name: IN_REQ_MINHOUR_TYPE

fixedLayoutFields.name: WL
fixedLayoutFields.description:
For Fall 2025, did your institution maintain a waitlist for first-time students?
A waitlist is a list of applicants who met admission requirements but were only to be admitted if space became available.

fixedLayoutFields.name: WL_RANKED
fixedLayoutFields.description: For Fall 2025, when your institution maintains a waitlist for first-time students, is your waitlist ranked?
fixedLayoutFields.validEntry:
If WL=1 (Yes), then 1=Yes, 2=No.
If WL=2 (No), then -2 or blank (not applicable), any entered value will be ignored.

fixedLayoutFields.name: WL_APPLICANTS
fixedLayoutFields.description:
For Fall 2025, when your institution maintains a ranked waitlist for first-time students, indicate the number of applicants placed on the waitlist and the number admitted.
- Number of applicants placed on waiting list
fixedLayoutFields.validEntry:
If WL_RANKED=1 (Yes), then 0 to 999999.
If WL_RANKED=2 (No) or blank, then -2 or blank (not applicable), any entered value will be ignored.

fixedLayoutFields.name: WL_ADMITTED
fixedLayoutFields.description:
For Fall 2025, when your institution maintains a ranked waitlist for first-time students, indicate whether students are notified of their place on the list, as well as the number of applicants placed on the listed and admitted, accepted, and enrolled.
- Number of applicants from waiting list admitted
fixedLayoutFields.validEntry:
If WL_RANKED=1 (Yes), then 0 to 999999.
If WL_RANKED=2 (No) or blank, then -2 or blank (not applicable), any entered value will be ignored.

fixedLayoutFields.name: ED_APPLICANTS

fixedLayoutFields.name: ED_ADMITTED
fixedLayoutFields.description: For Fall 2025,  when your institution permits first-time students to apply and be notified of an admission decision in advance of the regular notification date if the student commits to attending if accepted (Early Decision), report the number of applicants admitted for Early Decision.

fixedLayoutFields.name: ED_ADMITTED_ENROLLED

fixedLayoutFields.name: EA_APPLICANTS

Waitlist, Early Decision, and Early Action  [Applicable to Non-Open Admission institutions only] [Applicable only to first-time students]
Note, the 'WL' row is added on 9/4/25

keyValueFields.name: WL
keyValueFields.description:
For Fall 2025, did your institution maintain a waitlist for first-time students?
A waitlist is a list of applicants who met admission requirements but were only to be admitted if space became available.

keyValueFields.name: WL_RANKED
keyValueFields.description: For Fall 2025, when your institution maintains a waitlist for first-time students, is your waitlist ranked?
keyValueFields.validEntry:
If WL=1 (Yes), then 1=Yes, 2=No.
If WL=2 (No), then -2 or blank (not applicable), any entered value will be ignored.

keyValueFields.name: WL_APPLICANTS
keyValueFields.description:
For Fall 2025, when your institution maintains a ranked waitlist for first-time students, indicate the number of applicants placed on the waitlist and the number admitted.
- Number of applicants placed on waiting list
keyValueFields.validEntry:
If WL_RANKED=1 (Yes), then 0 to 999999.
If WL_RANKED=2 (No) or blank, then -2 or blank (not applicable), any entered value will be ignored.

keyValueFields.name: WL_ADMITTED
keyValueFields.description:
For Fall 2025, when your institution maintains a ranked waitlist for first-time students, indicate whether students are notified of their place on the list, as well as the number of applicants placed on the listed and admitted, accepted, and enrolled.
- Number of applicants from waiting list admitted
keyValueFields.validEntry:
If WL_RANKED=1 (Yes), then 0 to 999999.
If WL_RANKED=2 (No) or blank, then -2 or blank (not applicable), any entered value will be ignored.

keyValueFields.name: ED_APPLICANTS
keyValueFields.description: For Fall 2025,  when your institution permits first-time students to apply and be notified of an admission decision in advance of the regular notification date if the student commits to attending if accepted (Early Decision), report the number of applicants received for Early Decision.

keyValueFields.name: ED_ADMITTED
keyValueFields.description: For Fall 2025,  when your institution permits first-time students to apply and be notified of an admission decision in advance of the regular notification date if the student commits to attending if accepted (Early Decision), report the number of applicants admitted for Early Decision.

keyValueFields.name: ED_ADMITTED_ENROLLED
